question.text: A Cat III AIF can invest up to what percentage of investable funds in ONE underlying COMMODITY (subject to SEBI reporting)?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular, Cat III AIFs can invest up to 10% of investable funds in one underlying commodity, subject to reporting requirements. **The Trap:** Other percentages are incorrect. **Cross-Exam Context:** Parallel to the 10% investee company concentration limit. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Flag concentrated commodity positions in the fund's DD report to clients.
